name: Okuma Classic Pro XP Levelwind Reel: XP-202La
description: Okuma Classic Pro XP Levelwind Reels offer dependability and performance. These trolling reels are built with a lightweight, corrosion-resistant frame and sideplates, plus a fully machined and anodized aluminum spool for strength and durability. Classic Pro XP Levelwind Reels utilize aluminum power handles with comfortable Ergo grip knobs and powerful Rulidium drag components. The self-lubricating gear system releases oil as friction increases, keeping the drive shaft and main gear running smoothly. Okuma Classic Pro XP Levelwind Reels provide the quality of a higher-end trolling reel at a price you can afford.

name: Abu Garcia Revo S Low-Profile Casting Reel Model REVO4 S
description: The Abu Garcia Revo S Low-Profile Casting Reel is a lightweight, compact, and economical design with cutting edge technology and functionality. The sleek white profile of the Revo S reel is constructed of X2- Craftic alloy for added corrosion protection. The Abu Garcia Revo S Low-Profile Casting Reel will deliver results and much more at a valued price.

name: Nautilus X-Frame XL MAX 8-9 Fly Reel
description: This advanced large-arbor fly reel is a great choice for hard-charging fish like striped bass, bonefish, redfish and pike. Made from supertough, corrosion-resistant aircraft-grade aluminum. SCF-X Disc Brake Technology drag system has the stopping power you need. The ideal fly reel for most inshore species of saltwater fish plus large freshwater fish. Large drag knob is easy for cold, wet fingers to grip. Nautilus X-Frame design creates a skeletonized frame that is incredibly light and strong. The X-Frame design features strong beams that extend from the center to the wide line guard. These angles allow for protection when the rod is leaned up against a wall or a car. Teflon-and-carbon-fiber SCF-X drag system is sealed to protect against saltwater and sand. Large-arbor design allows superfast line pickup. Made in the USA.
